en: This is an emergency alert system broadcast.
zh: 这里是紧急警报系统广播。

en: This is not a test.
Hello, citizen.
Due to unforeseen and unexplained events, the city has been quarantined.
zh: 由于发生无法预见、无法解释的事件，本城已实施隔离。

en: Please stay home.
Lock all your doors and windows.
Stay out of sight until further notice.
zh: 在另行通知前，不要露面。

en: Repeat.
It is crucial that you stay in your home and out of sight.
zh: 务必留在家中，不要露面。

en: Martial law is now in effect, and anyone trying to exit the city will be shot on sight.
zh: 戒严令现已生效，任何试图出城者将被当场击毙。

en: This is not an exercise. Stay home until further notice.
zh: 这不是演习。在另行通知前，请留在家中。

en: This is bad.
It's not an isolated case.
It just got up and started walking.
zh: 它刚刚站起来，接着就开始走了。

en: [unit] to base.
Sector C was already overwhelmed.
What do you want us to do?
They're freaking dead and still walking, goddammit.
zh: 它们他妈的已经死了，还在走，该死的。

en: Get a hold of yourself.
We're trained to handle anything.
zh: 我们受过训练，什么都能应付。

en: What the hell? Walking dead? Shit, I'm not staying here.
zh: 搞什么鬼？活死人？妈的，我才不待在这儿。

en: Confirmed.
What's the status on the undead activity?
The patients are still too high, sir.
zh: 长官，感染人数还是太多。

en: Status ETA, 10 seconds.
There's a lot of undead movement.
